newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Samara Eurobond to be $500 mln,autumn issue.
newsitem.headline: Russia Samara Eurobond to be $500 mln,autumn issue.

text.p: Russia's Samara region increased the volume of its planned Eurobond issue to $500 million and postponed the issue to autumn, a regional administration official said on Friday.
"We are planning the issue for autumn for up to $500 million," Financial Resources Department Head Yelena Timofeyeva told Reuters.
Previously regional authorities said the Eurobond would be between $250 million and $400 million and launched in July.
Timofeyeva said the administration would choose a lead-manager from Goldman Sachs, CS First Boston and ING Barings in the next few days.
